$comment: Seed data for scripts/dev-mock/server.mjs. "@now-3h" becomes an ISO time, "@date-2d" a YYYY-MM-DD date and "@ms-3h" epoch milliseconds, all relative to server start. Prices are a snapshot, so unrealised P&L against live prices will drift. suggestions_cache holds made-up reads (one long, one short) so the idea-to-ticket path can be exercised; they are not real signals.
